whyThisIsGolden: Explicitly claims payment capability via an NFT-style 'attributes' trait: {"trait_type": "Payment", "value": "HTTP 402 Supported"}.
Declares zero working endpoints: 'endpoints' is an empty object and 'capabilities' is an empty array.

Doesn't even use the ERC-8004 registration-file schema (no 'type', no 'services' array) — it uses an NFT/OpenSea-style 'attributes' shape instead, which our extractServiceEndpointUrls() correctly does not credit as declaring a service.
'image' is the bare string 'www.google.com', not a URL — another sign this registration was never meant to be machine-consumed per spec.
